get.summary: Get application version and instance info
get.description: Public. Returns the whole package.json (name, version, ...) plus runtime info. The licence token itself is never returned, only the parsed state.

isDemo.description: Value of UREPORT_IS_DEMO env var (e.g. "true"), absent when unset

post.summary: Log in with username and password
post.description: Public (rate limited). Terminates the user\'s other sessions (except the demo user on a demo instance). Blocks the demo user on non-demo instances.

403.description: Account not active, or demo user on non-demo instance

post.summary: Log out current session
post.description: No auth middleware is applied; destroys the current session and writes a LOGOUT audit record.

post.summary: Register a new user account
post.description: Public unless an authenticated admin sets adminCreated=true (then the user is created active with the given role and the licence seat limit is enforced). Otherwise the user is created with role viewer and status pending; if SMTP is configured a confirmation email is sent (token valid 24h). Disabled in demo mode. Username "demo" is rejected.

400.description: Missing fields, username not allowed, or username already exists

403.description: Demo mode, or user seat limit reached ({ error, limit })

adminCreated.description: Only honoured when the caller is an authenticated admin

role.description: Only used when adminCreated is true

get.summary: Confirm email address via token

200.description: Email confirmed, user is now active

get.summary: Get the current session
get.description: Checks req.isAuthenticated() inside the handler (session login).

get.summary: Get API token status for the current user
get.description: Session login required (checked in handler). Never returns the full token, only a masked preview.

post.summary: Generate an API token for the current user
post.description: Session login required (checked in handler). Replaces any existing token. The full token is only returned here.

post.summary: Request a password reset email
post.description: Public (rate limited). Token valid 1 hour. Always 200 for unknown accounts ({ msg }); the email is only sent when system email settings are configured. SSO accounts get 400.

200.description: { success: true } when processed, or { msg } when no such account exists

get.summary: Validate a password reset token

post.summary: Reset password using token
post.description: Public (rate limited). On success the user is also logged in (req.logIn).

200.description: Result (always 200; success=false when the token is invalid or expired)

post.summary: List users (paginated)
post.description: Requires role operator or admin (readAny user); viewer gets 403. Password and apiToken are excluded from results. page is 0-based; perPage <= 0 becomes 10 and values above 50 are capped at 50.

200.description: Array of users (a negative page returns { error: true, message } with 200)

post.summary: Get total user count
post.description: Requires role operator or admin (readAny user); viewer gets 403. Password and apiToken are excluded from results.

post.summary: Search users by username (case-insensitive partial match)
post.description: Requires role operator or admin (readAny user); viewer gets 403. Password and apiToken are excluded from results.

post.summary: Get users by id list
post.description: Requires role operator or admin (readAny user); viewer gets 403. Password and apiToken are excluded from results. Returns [] when ids is missing or empty.

put.description: Allowed for admin (updateAny) or for the user themself (matched by username). Password cannot be changed here. Only admins may set role (audited). Applied fields: username, email, role, displayname, position, settings.language/theme/report/dashboard.

400.description: Password in body, non-admin sets role, new username taken, or username to update not found

username.description: New username, must not be taken

get.summary: List users pending approval
get.description: Requires role operator or admin (readAny user); viewer gets 403. Password and apiToken are excluded from results. Sorted newest first.

put.description: Admin only. Sets status active; enforces licence seat limit. Audited.

403.description: Forbidden, or seat limit reached ({ error, limit })

put.description: Admin only. Sets status rejected. Audited.

put.summary: Admin reset of a user password (no current password needed)
put.description: Admin only. Not allowed for SSO accounts. Audited.

400.description: newPassword missing, or account uses SSO

post.summary: Change current user password
post.description: Any authenticated user. Not allowed for SSO accounts.

400.description: Missing fields, SSO account, or current password incorrect

get.summary: List distinct active lanes
get.description: Requires authentication. Distinct product/type/team/browser/device/platform/platform_version/stage/extras combinations of non-archived builds started within the last N days. Not filtered by license lane quota.

get.summary: Get a build by ID
get.description: Requires authentication.

put.description: Requires authentication. Requires update permission on build (admin, operator).

delete.summary: Delete a build and its tests
delete.description: Requires authentication. Requires delete permission on build (admin only). Deletes the build, then all tests of that build; writes a BUILD_DELETE audit record. Returns 200 even if the build does not exist.

200.description: Delete result of the build's tests

post.summary: Create or update a build
post.description: Requires authentication. Requires create permission on build (admin, operator). A build is matched by build number, is_archive, product, type and the lane fields (version, team, browser, device, platform, platform_version, stage, extras); an unset lane field matches builds where it is also unset. If a match exists it is updated, otherwise a new build is created.

200.description: Build created or updated (saved build document)

400.description: Product, Type or Build is mandatory

put.description: Requires authentication. Requires update permission on build (admin, operator). The pass/fail/skip/warning values are added to the build\'s current counters and total is recomputed.

post.summary: Recalculate build status from test results
post.description: Requires authentication. Requires update permission on build (admin, operator). Uses the last status per test uid of the build (RERUN_ prefix stripped). When is_update_build_status is true (default) the build status/end_time are saved and quarantine rules and plugin hooks are triggered.

404.description: Build id not found, or no tests found for the build

is_update_build_status.description: Persist the calculated status to the build

post.summary: Get latest status per lane
post.description: Requires authentication. Requires read permission on build (all roles). Groups matching builds by lane and returns the most recent build of each.

_id.description: Lane key (product, type, version, team, browser, device, platform, platform_version, stage, extras)

400.description: query must be a non-empty array

query.description: Non-empty array of Mongo match conditions, combined with $or (mandatory)

post.summary: Add a comment to a build
post.description: Requires authentication. Restricted to roles admin and operator.

comment.description: Comment object appended to the build comments

put.summary: Replace the comments of a build
put.description: Requires authentication. Restricted to roles admin and operator.

post.summary: Add a comment to a build outage
post.description: Requires authentication. The outage is identified by search_type + pattern. No role check beyond authentication.

400.description: search_type, pattern or comment is mandatory

comment.description: Comment appended to the outage comments

post.summary: Add or update an outage on a build
post.description: Requires authentication. Requires update permission on outage (admin, operator).

schema.description: Outage definition; outage is matched by search_type + pattern

post.summary: Get the latest builds of given products/types
post.description: Requires authentication. product and type are arrays of values (OR-ed). Results are sorted by start_time descending and limited to range.

get.summary: Get distinct build entity values
get.description: Requires authentication.

200.description: One single-key object per entity: product, type, version, device, team, browser

get.summary: Get distinct products and types
get.description: Requires authentication.

post.summary: Recommend lanes for a product/type
post.description: Requires authentication. Returns distinct lane combinations started within the last since days. Optional lane fields are case-insensitive regular expressions (invalid/unsafe regex returns 400); extras are exact matches.

200.description: Recommendations. When nothing matches the response is an empty array.

400.description: Product/Type is mandatory, or invalid regex in a field

post.summary: Get lane values for a product/type
post.description: Requires authentication. Distinct values per field for the given product/type, optionally narrowed by the other lane fields (exact match). The unfiltered result is cached for 10 minutes.

200.description: Array of single-key objects: version, device, team, browser, platform, platform_version, stage (each an array of values) and a final { extras: { <key>: [values] } }

post.summary: Count builds
post.description: Requires authentication. All fields optional; exact-match filters.

200.description: Total number of matching builds (a bare JSON number)

post.summary: Calculate which builds a purge would delete
post.description: Requires authentication. Requires update permission on build (admin, operator). product and type are mandatory unless untilDate is given. When a lane field (or extras) is present in the body as null, only builds with that field unset match; fields omitted entirely are not constrained.

test_count.description: Number of tests belonging to those builds

post.summary: Purge builds and their tests
post.description: Requires authentication. Requires delete permission on build (admin only). Deletes the listed builds and their tests; quarantine records of a product/type lane are removed when no builds remain for it.

builds.description: Build IDs to delete (typically from purge/calculate)

post.summary: Search latest builds per lane
post.description: Requires authentication. Either pass specificQueries, or product and type (mandatory then). product/type/team/platform/stage are matched case-insensitively and exactly unless they contain ^, $ or | (then treated as a regex). Results are grouped per lane; each has aggregate_previous_runs holding the last range runs.

400.description: Product/Type is mandatory, or invalid regex in a field

specificQueries.description: When set, used as $or query and product/type are not required

range.description: Number of previous runs kept per lane

post.summary: List builds (paginated)
post.description: Requires authentication. page is zero-based. perPage <= 0 becomes 10 and values above 50 are capped at 50. A negative page returns 200 with { error: true, message }. Each build carries aggregate_previous_runs with at most one earlier build of the same lane.

200.description: Builds of the page (empty array when none)

get.summary: Get a test by UID
get.description: Requires authentication. Returns the first test with this uid (selected fields only).

get.summary: Get a test by ID
get.description: Requires authentication. If no test matches, the response is 200 with a null body.

post.summary: Upload a test screenshot
post.description: Requires authentication. Requires create permission on test (admin, operator). Multipart upload, field name image; jpg/jpeg/png only, max 5 MB.

post.summary: Create multiple tests in one request
post.description: Requires authentication. Requires create permission on test (admin, operator). Maximum 100 tests per request.

400.description: Missing tests, or more than 100 tests

isOrdered.description: Insert in order; stops at first error when true

post.summary: Update test status and comments
post.description: Requires authentication. Requires update permission on test (admin, operator). Writes an audit record when status is given.

post.summary: Get run history of a test by UID
post.description: Requires authentication. Returns runs of the uid with start_time <= before, newest first. Note: include is read unconditionally, so omitting it fails the request.

include.description: Fields to return: array of names, a single name, or 'all' for every field. Typical default: start_time, end_time, status, failure, is_rerun, build

post.summary: Filter tests of builds
post.description: Requires authentication. Results sorted by uid ascending.

build.description: Build ID, or array of build IDs (mandatory)

status.description: Status or list of statuses; 'All' matches everything

exclude.description: Field names to strip from each test

post.summary: Get all tests of builds (cached)
post.description: Requires authentication. Per-build results are cached; status filtering and field exclusion are applied in memory. Includes rerun tests.

build.description: Build ID, or array of build IDs (mandatory)

status.description: Status or list of statuses; 'All' matches everything

exclude.description: Field names to strip from each test

post.summary: Find a test by ID (POST)
post.description: Requires authentication. Requires create permission on test (admin, operator).

post.summary: Aggregate stable tests across builds
post.description: Requires authentication. Tests (non-rerun) that have the same status, all PASS, all FAIL or all SKIP, in every given build.

404.description: builds list is mandatory (note: returned as 404)

post.summary: Aggregate unstable tests across builds
post.description: Requires authentication. Tests (non-rerun) whose FAIL+SKIP rate is above 0 and below 0.9, sorted by rate descending.

404.description: builds list is mandatory (note: returned as 404)

post.summary: Get per-test result trend over builds
post.description: Requires authentication.

404.description: builds list is mandatory (note: returned as 404)

post.summary: Get history of a single test UID across builds
post.description: Requires authentication. Newest first, max 500 entries, each with its build info.

post.summary: Find non-passing tests by failure details
post.description: Requires authentication. Non-PASS tests since the given date (default: the system analysisSinceDay setting, 30 days), newest first, optionally filtered by uid or failure fields.

200.description: Matching test runs with build info

post.summary: Rebuild the test cache for builds
post.description: Requires authentication. Requires delete permission on test (admin only).

get.summary: Get a test relation by ID
get.description: Requires authentication. If nothing matches, the response is 200 with a null body.

delete.summary: Delete a test relation by ID
delete.description: Requires authentication. Requires delete permission on relation (admin, operator). Returns 200 even if nothing matched.

post.summary: Count test relations
post.description: Requires authentication.

post.summary: Filter test relations by product and type
post.description: Requires authentication.

post.summary: Create or update a test relation (upsert)
post.description: Requires authentication. Requires create permission on relation (admin, operator). Matched by _id if given, else by uid (+ product, type when given); created when nothing matches. The whole body is applied as the update.

post.summary: List test relations (paginated)
post.description: Requires authentication. page is zero-based. perPage <= 0 becomes 10 and values above 50 are capped at 50. A negative page returns 200 with { error: true, message }.

get.summary: Get an investigated test by ID
get.description: Requires authentication. If nothing matches, the response is 200 with a null body.

post.summary: Create or update an investigated test (upsert)
post.description: Requires authentication. With _id in the body this updates that record and needs update permission on investigate (admin, operator); without _id a new record is created and needs create permission (admin, operator). Top-level keys starting with $ are stripped. Writes a "Triaged" audit record.

post.summary: Create multiple investigated tests
post.description: Requires authentication. Requires create permission on investigate (admin, operator). The body is a JSON array. One audit record covers the whole batch. On an insert error the error object is returned with status 200.

delete.description: Requires authentication. Admin can delete any record. Other roles need delete-own permission on investigate must equal their own user id. Writes an audit record.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: User id of the requester (must be the caller for non-admins)

post.summary: Count investigated tests
post.description: Requires authentication.

filter.description: Text matched (as escaped regex) against uid and tracking.track_number

get.summary: Count investigated tests using a customize state
get.description: Requires authentication. Counts records whose customize_state._id equals the given id.

200.description: Aggregation result: [{ total: n }], empty array when none

post.summary: Filter investigated tests by product and type
post.description: Requires authentication. Only records created since fromDate (default: now minus the system analysisSinceDay setting, 30 days). With activeRegEx, product/type are case-insensitive regexes and fromDate is ignored (the analysisSinceDay window is used).

400.description: Product/Type is mandatory, or invalid regex pattern

post.summary: Add a comment to an investigated test
post.description: Requires authentication. No role check beyond authentication.

comment.description: Comment object appended to the comments list

put.summary: Replace the comments of an investigated test
put.description: Requires authentication. No role check beyond authentication.

post.summary: List investigated tests (paginated)
post.description: Requires authentication. page is zero-based. perPage <= 0 becomes 10 and values above 50 are capped at 50. A negative page returns 200 with { error: true, message }.

get.summary: Get an assignment by ID
get.description: Any authenticated user.

put.description: Requires updateAny assignment (operator or admin). Applied fields: comments, username, user, state, failure. State CLOSE with username is audited as Unassign.

delete.description: Requires deleteAny assignment (operator or admin). Audited.

post.summary: Search assignments (assignments page)
post.description: Any authenticated user. Sorted by assign_at descending.

after.description: assign_at lower bound, default 90 days ago

post.summary: Bulk create or append assignments (max 50)
post.description: Requires createAny assignment (operator or admin). Items without uid, product or type are skipped. An OPEN assignment for the same product/type/uid is appended to instead of creating a new one. One email per assignee is sent after the response.

put.summary: Bulk resolve OPEN assignments by id
put.description: Role admin or operator. Sets state RESOLVED on OPEN assignments.

post.summary: Send follow-up reminder emails for OPEN assignments
post.description: Role admin or operator. Non-admins only reach assignments they assigned themselves. The assigner is never emailed.

post.summary: Filter assignments by product/type conditions
post.description: Any authenticated user. Sorted by assign_at descending. Only assignments with assign_at >= after (default: now) are returned.

post.summary: Create an assignment (appends to an existing OPEN one for the same failure)
post.description: Requires createAny assignment (operator or admin). assigned_by_user/username are set from the caller. Sends an assignment email and audits.

post.summary: Add a comment to an assignment
post.description: Any authenticated user.

put.summary: Replace the comments of an assignment
put.description: Any authenticated user. The whole comments array is replaced.

get.summary: List quarantined test UIDs
get.description: Requires authentication.

parameters.name: is_active
parameters.description: Filter on is_active; any value other than 'true' means false

delete.description: Requires authentication. Restricted to role admin. Hard delete.

post.summary: Filter quarantined tests
post.description: Requires authentication.

min_cycle.description: Only records with cycle >= min_cycle (applied when > 1)

scope.description: Build scope: version, team, browser, device, platform, platform_version, stage (string or array of strings), extras_key or extras. Empty stored values act as wildcards.

get.summary: Get quarantine cycle history of a test
get.description: Requires authentication. Newest first.

put.description: Requires authentication. Sets is_active=false and resolved_at=now (server side) and records a history entry. No role check beyond authentication.

is_exempt.description: true marks the test exempt (resolved_by=exempt), false clears the exemption

delete.description: Requires authentication. Restricted to role admin. Hard delete (release); writes an audit record. Returns 200 with a null body when nothing matched.

post.summary: Get top failing tests
post.description: Any authenticated user. Counts FAIL (non-rerun) results across non-archived builds matching the lane filters since the given date (default 30 days ago).

200.description: Top failing tests sorted by failCount desc (empty array when no builds match)

since.description: Top-failures/slowest-tests: ISO date (default 30 days ago). Pass-rate/duration history: number of days (default 90).

post.summary: Get pass-rate trend across recent builds
post.description: Any authenticated user. Sums pass/total across matching lanes per build position, oldest first. Anomaly detection (z-score, isAnomaly when zScore < -1.5) only applies with 3 or more points.

since.description: Top-failures/slowest-tests: ISO date (default 30 days ago). Pass-rate/duration history: number of days (default 90).

post.summary: Get build duration trend across recent builds
post.description: Any authenticated user. Builds without positive duration are dropped.

200.description: Build duration history in chronological order

since.description: Top-failures/slowest-tests: ISO date (default 30 days ago). Pass-rate/duration history: number of days (default 90).

post.summary: Get slowest tests by average duration
post.description: Any authenticated user. Only PASS, FAIL and RERUN_PASS non-rerun results with start and end times are considered; since defaults to 30 days ago.

200.description: Slowest tests sorted by avgDuration desc (milliseconds; empty array when no builds match)

since.description: Top-failures/slowest-tests: ISO date (default 30 days ago). Pass-rate/duration history: number of days (default 90).

post.summary: Get top flaky/failing tests across all products
post.description: Any authenticated user. Looks at up to the 1000 most recent non-archived builds since the given date, keeps tests with at least 3 failures, sorts by fail rate and caps results at 5 per product:type lane. Response is cached server-side for 2 hours per since/limit.

200.description: Top failing tests (empty array when no builds match)

post.summary: Count tests that both passed and failed in the window
post.description: Any authenticated user. Counts distinct test uids with both PASS and FAIL (non-rerun) results across up to the 1000 most recent non-archived builds since the given date. Cached server-side for 2 hours per since value.

get.summary: Get a dashboard by ID
get.description: Any authenticated user. Returns 404 with { error } when not found.

put.description: Body.user is mandatory. Requires update permission on own dashboards or update-any permission.

403.description: You don't have permission to perform this action

post.summary: Delete a dashboard by ID (uses POST)
post.description: Body.user (owner id) is mandatory. Requires delete permission on own dashboards or delete-any permission. Responds with the Mongo deleteOne result.

403.description: You don't have permission to perform this action

get.summary: Get dashboards belonging to a user
Get public dashboards not owned by a user
get.description: Returns all dashboards with is_public = true whose owner is not the given userId.

post.summary: Create or update a dashboard
post.description: Body.user is mandatory. If body._id is present the dashboard is upserted by _id, otherwise a new one is created. Requires create permission (own dashboards) or update-any permission on the dashboard component.

403.description: You don't have permission to perform this action

post.summary: Generate or regenerate a dashboard share token
post.description: No request body. Requires update permission on own dashboard and the dashboard_sharing license feature (Pro).

403.description: No permission, or dashboard sharing requires a Pro license

delete.description: Sets share_token to null. Requires update permission on own dashboard and the dashboard_sharing license feature (Pro).

403.description: No permission, or dashboard sharing requires a Pro license

post.summary: Add a widget to a dashboard
post.description: Body.user (dashboard owner id) is mandatory; the remaining body fields are the widget definition passed to Dashboard.addWidget. Requires update permission on own dashboard or update-any permission.

403.description: You don't have permission to perform this action

get.summary: Get a dashboard template by ID
get.description: Any authenticated user.

put.summary: Update a dashboard template by ID
put.description: Body.user is mandatory. Requires update permission on own template.

403.description: You don't have permission to perform this action

post.summary: Delete a dashboard template by ID (uses POST)
post.description: Body.user (owner id) is mandatory. Requires delete permission on own template. Responds with the Mongo deleteOne result.

403.description: You don't have permission to perform this action

get.summary: Get all dashboard templates
get.description: Returns every template (no per-user filtering).

get.summary: Get all public dashboard templates
get.description: Requires authentication (mounted behind isAuthenticatedMid). Returns templates with is_public = true.

post.summary: Create or update a dashboard template
post.description: Body.user is mandatory. If body._id is present the template is upserted by _id (requires update permission on own template); otherwise a new template is created (requires create-any permission).

403.description: You don't have permission to perform this action

get.summary: Get a setting by ID
get.description: Any authenticated user.

put.description: Admin only. Audited. Only fields present in the body are applied (product, type, description, issue_type, product_line, component_filter, relations_filter, custom_execution_script, investigated_setting, notification, quarantine_rules, auto_triage_settings, auto_heal_settings, default_framework). Unlike create, notification.rules is NOT stripped by licence on update.

get.summary: Get all settings
get.description: Any authenticated user.

post.summary: Create a new setting
post.description: Admin only. Audited. notification.rules is stripped from the body when the licence does not include the notifications feature. product + type must be unique.

400.description: A setting already exists with the Product and Test Type

post.summary: Find the setting for a product and type
post.description: Any authenticated user. Returns at most one setting.

post.summary: Find a setting that is shared with a product and type
post.description: Any authenticated user. Matches share_with.product and share_with.type via aggregate (limit 1). Raw aggregate: documents are not run through the Setting schema.

get.summary: Get a system setting by name (e.g. SYSTEM_SETTING)
get.description: Requires readAny setting (all roles). Secrets (ai.api_key, notification.email.password, license_key, sso.*.client_secret) are returned as "••••". On write, a missing/empty/masked secret keeps the stored value. Served from the in-memory cache unless isforce=true.

200.description: System setting (or { error } with 200 when SYSTEM_SETTING does not exist yet)

404.description: Setting name other than SYSTEM_SETTING not found

put.summary: Update a system setting by ID
put.description: Admin only. Secrets (ai.api_key, notification.email.password, license_key, sso.*.client_secret) are returned as "••••". On write, a missing/empty/masked secret keeps the stored value. Setting license_key to a new value validates and activates the licence; clearing it reverts to community. audit_retention_days re-applies the audit TTL index. Applied fields: analysisSinceDay, advance_analysis_settings, suggested_issue_types, notification, issue_tracking, tc_management, ai, license_key, framework_presets, audit_retention_days, sso.

post.summary: Create or update the SYSTEM_SETTING document (upsert)
post.description: Admin only. Secrets (ai.api_key, notification.email.password, license_key, sso.*.client_secret) are returned as "••••". On write, a missing/empty/masked secret keeps the stored value. Upserts the document named SYSTEM_SETTING with the request body as-is (runValidators, setDefaultsOnInsert).

post.summary: Run AI root cause analysis for a failing test
post.description: Requires role admin or operator and a license that includes the auto-triage feature. Results are cached by a hash of the error message and stack trace; identical failures in the same build are returned as siblingTestIds.

403.description: Role not admin/operator, or licence lacks auto-triage

404.description: Test not found, or build not found for test

503.description: AI not configured ({ error, configured: false })

patch.summary: Record human-confirmed cause for AI accuracy tracking
patch.description: Any authenticated user. Updates the most recent analysis record for test_id.

get.summary: Fetch all AI analysis records for a product/type

200.description: AI analysis records, newest first (fields test_id, result, provider, model, created_at)

get.summary: Check if AI provider is configured and reachable
get.description: Makes a live chat call to the provider. When no provider is configured returns 200 with configured false and provider null.

502.description: Provider configured but the chat call failed

get.summary: Check whether an AI provider is configured (no AI call)
get.description: Any authenticated user.

get.summary: Get all presets
get.description: Any authenticated user. Sorted by name.

post.summary: Create a preset
post.description: Admin only. All lanes must share the same product and type.

400.description: No lanes, lanes differ in product/type, or name already exists

put.description: Admin only. lanes is validated on every update (at least one lane, all sharing product and type), so it must be sent. name and description are only changed when present.

400.description: Lane validation failed or name already exists

post.summary: Update dashboard preference for a user
post.description: Authenticated; body.user must be the caller\'s own user id (updateOwn preference). Returns the saved user. Replaces settings.dashboard with body.dashboard.

post.summary: Update report preference for a user
post.description: Authenticated; body.user must be the caller\'s own user id (updateOwn preference). Returns the saved user. Replaces settings.report with body.report.

post.summary: Update language preference for a user
post.description: Authenticated; body.user must be the caller\'s own user id (updateOwn preference). Returns the saved user. Replaces settings.language with body.language.

post.summary: Update theme preference for a user
post.description: Authenticated; body.user must be the caller\'s own user id (updateOwn preference). Returns the saved user. Replaces settings.theme with body.theme.

post.summary: Update filter favorites preference for a user
post.description: Authenticated; body.user must be the caller\'s own user id (updateOwn preference). Returns the saved user. Replaces settings.filter_favorites with body.filter_favorites.

get.summary: Get favorites of a user
get.description: Authenticated; the id/userid must be the caller\'s own user id (own-only: viewer, operator, admin).

200.description: Favorites document, or null when none exists

put.summary: Update favorites of a user (upserts when none exists)
put.description: Authenticated; the id/userid must be the caller\'s own user id (own-only: viewer, operator, admin).

delete.description: Authenticated; the id/userid must be the caller\'s own user id (own-only: viewer, operator, admin). Quirk in the code: the permission check compares id with the caller\'s user id, but the delete filter is { _id: id } (the favorites document id), so it only deletes when both coincide.

post.summary: Create or update favorites (upsert by userid)
post.description: Authenticated; the body.userid must be the caller\'s own user id (own-only: viewer, operator, admin). Applied on update: username, executions, pinned, ceses, workspaces.

post.summary: Match failing tests against existing investigations and optionally create auto-triage records
post.description: Matches the supplied failing tests against recent investigations (source pool) of the same product/type. Match priority per test: token, then exact error message, then stack trace. Tests already covered by a valid investigation are skipped. Requires auto_triage_settings.enabled for the product/type. With dryRun (the default) nothing is written; with dryRun=false, an auto-triage InvestigatedTest document is upserted per match (keyed by uid + product + type + is_auto_triaged). Token matches and promoted uids get ttl -1 (permanent); other matches get auto_triage_settings.ttl_days (default 5). Source investigations older than auto_triage_settings.max_source_age_days (default 30) are ignored; fuzzy-match sources (similarity != 100) and expired auto-triage sources are skipped. If auto_triage_settings.scope_filter.relations is set, only tests whose relations match the filter are considered. The same logic also runs automatically on build completion (non-dry-run).

200.description: Evaluation result. matches lists every matched test; created is the number of auto-triage documents upserted (always 0 for a dry run, when there are no matches, or when no tests are eligible). _debug is present for dry runs, and when no source investigations exist; it is omitted on a successful non-dry-run with matches, and when no tests are eligible.

sourceUid.description: uid of the source investigation that matched.

sourceTrackingNumber.description: Source tracking.track_number as string, or empty string.

eligibleTestsSent.description: Number of tests not already covered by an existing investigation.

400.description: Validation or configuration error. Messages: "product and type are required"; "auto-triage is not enabled for this product/type"; "auto_triage_settings.ttl_days must be >= 1".

401.description: Not authenticated (rejected by the authentication middleware on /api/investigated_test).

500.description: Database or processing error. error is the underlying error message, or "auto-triage failed".

get.summary: Start the OAuth2 login flow for a provider
get.description: Absolute path: GET /auth/sso/{provider} (outside the /api prefix). Public. Browser navigation endpoint, not a JSON API. Passport redirects (302) to the provider authorization_url with the configured scope (default "openid email profile") and state=true (state stored in the session). The strategy is re-registered from SystemSetting.sso on every request. The slug "saml" is skipped (passed on to the next handler).

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Provider slug, a key of SystemSetting.sso (e.g. google).

302.description: Redirect to the identity provider authorization endpoint; or, if the sso feature is not licensed, redirect to /login?error=sso_not_licensed.

404.description: Provider not configured, not enabled, or missing client_id/client_secret.

error.example: SSO provider not configured or not enabled

get.summary: OAuth2 callback — completes login and creates a session
get.description: Absolute path: GET /auth/sso/{provider}/callback (outside the /api prefix). Public; registered as the redirect URI (callback_url) with the identity provider. Always responds with a 302. Exchanges the code for a token, fetches userinfo (userinfo_url), then findOrCreate: match by sso_sub+sso_provider, else link by email, else JIT-provision a new user (default_role viewer|operator). allowed_domains and license seat limit are enforced. On success the session is regenerated (session fixation prevention), all other sessions of that user are marked terminated, the user is logged in (session cookie set) and the browser is redirected to /nextgen/login?sso=1. On any failure the browser is redirected to /login?error=<code>. The slug "saml" is skipped (passed on to the next handler). This endpoint does not check the sso license itself.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Provider slug, a key of SystemSetting.sso.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: Authorization code issued by the identity provider.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: State value echoed by the provider; validated against the session by passport.

302.description: Success: Location /nextgen/login?sso=1 (session cookie set). Failure: Location /login?error=<code>, where code is sso_failed (provider not configured, auth/userinfo error, missing email, session error), domain_not_allowed, account_inactive, or seat_limit.
